title: Russian Fricatives
why_promising: Primary Russian read-speech corpus; 198 sentences, 77 recording sessions, 22,561 target-fricative tokens. Recording_1 target-fricative boundaries were manually inspected and corrected in Praat after MAUS preprocessing; companion TextGrids and extracted target-fricative WAVs exist. Recording_2 is automatic-only and must be excluded from the manual core.
open_question: Access is contract-restricted through SWISSUbase and redistribution is prohibited. Verify exact Recording_1 file counts/token count and obtain metadata/TextGrid bytes through an authorized research login before row-level ingestion; preserve references/checksums rather than restricted files in GitHub.
